title: Standard-sign product projections on the native bifunctor Hom
statement: Let $B$ be a preadditive category with countable products and $H:B^{\mathrm{op}}\to B\to B$ additive in both variables. Define $\operatorname{nativeHomComplex}(H)$ to be the simultaneous native product-Hom bifunctor: on $(K,I)$ its value is $\operatorname{bifunctorHomObj}(H,K,I)$, and a pair $(f^{\mathrm{op}},g)$ acts by native precomposition by $f$ followed by native postcomposition by $g$. Define $\operatorname{standardHomModel}(H)$ as the StandardModel of [def-sf-ringed-two-injective-models] with that underlying complex bifunctor and projection $\pi^{n}_{p,q}=(-1)^{np}\pi^{n,\mathrm{nat}}_{p,q}$ for $p+n=q$. Its product universal property, standard differential $d_I f-(-1)^n f d_K$, and ordinary pre/postcomposition equations are proved in the construction. Thus the identity on the underlying complex is the native-to-standard chain isomorphism with the prescribed signed components. The native complexes use the row-sign differential described in [lem-sf-bifunctor-homotopy-exact].
